details: The agent faithfully executed the proposed analysis in analysis_info.json. Both Task1 and Task2 were completed using the specified dataset and Python scripts. Task1 implemented partial correlations between DSM5_Total and MiniK_Total/HKSS_Total controlling for Age, with listwise deletion and outputs in data/results_task1.json. Task2 constructed MiniK groups (fast <= -1, slow >= 1, excluding -1 < score < 1), conducted Levene and Shapiro-Wilk tests, and ran a two-sided Mann-Whitney U, saving results to data/results_task2.json. The execution logs confirm container build/run, human approval, script execution, and outputs. Reported statistics in execution_results.json match the generated result files. No major deviations from the planned methods were observed.
